topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: It seems the boundaries of our little worlds are about to change. My neighbor, with a smile that doesn't quite reach his eyes, has decided it's time for a fence. A structure meant to define, to separate, to perhaps even safeguard what he deems his own. The thought of it being erected, standing tall and unyielding, brings a curious tightness to my chest. I find myself contemplating the altered landscape, the conversations that might now echo differently across a yard newly divided. I wonder if this is a change we truly needed, if it will speak more of trust or of the walls we build between ourselves.
